Agent interface evaluation

Roadmap items 1–4 of plans/agent-interface.md: Processes opting out, the read-only agent API (phase 1a), the MCP server with its stdio shim, and the toolbelt CLI with its skill file. Each case is a request a person might make. Claude played the agent: it picked the tool calls, read what ToolBelt returned and wrote the answer shown.

Most urgent: Submit November expense report is overdue (due Sat, Nov 21, Finance).

Tomorrow at 2:00 PM: Q4 budget review with finance. It has stalled (untouched for 3 days) and its subtask Draft budget slides hasn't started.

In progress: Migrate CI to the new runners (untouched 2 days). Stalled and blocked: Fix flaky remote-access test (6 days).

Coming up: Renew passport (Sat, Nov 28, high priority) and Plan team offsite agenda (Dec 5). Waiting: the Acme printer quote, check-in due tonight around 00:24. The dentist booking is snoozed until Dec 1.

I'd start with the expense report, then prepare for tomorrow's budget review.

8. Are there ToolBelt or plugin updates?

partial
Person chatting with Claude Desktop · MCP
Is there a new version of ToolBelt or of my plugins?
  • toolbelt_status
  • list_plugins

The agent's answer

ToolBelt reports an app update to 0.2.0. That's older than the 0.3.24 you run, so it's probably the preview's simulated update feed, not a real release. The plugins I can see are current: Upkeep 0.2.0, OnTrack 0.14.0 and SDK Explorer 0.2.1. One plugin isn't shared with agents, so I can't tell you about its updates.

Notes

The data was correct for what's visible. Two caveats: the browser preview fakes app updates, and list_plugins leaves out plugins kept from agents, so an agent can't say whether every plugin is current (finding O4).

The agent's answer

You settled Submit November expense report at 22:28. It moved from Inbox (overdue) to Settled.

Notes

The subscription kept the screen open and the notification arrived after about 1 s, as throttled. The notification carries no diff, so the watcher re-read the whole screen (about 8k characters) and compared it with the earlier read itself (finding O2). The setup reopened the task afterwards, which is why later reads show "Reopened from Settled".

The agent's answer
Your OnTrack window is searching for "finance" right now, so I can only see the 3 matching tasks. Among them, Q4 budget review with finance is due tomorrow at 2 PM, and Submit November expense report is already overdue (Nov 21). Clear the search in OnTrack and ask again for the full week.


Notes
The read flagged the shared view state (search "finance"), so the agent didn't claim the list was complete. It still couldn't read past the person's search: challenge C6, addressed by parameterized reads (1c) and per-viewer instances (1d).

Found and fixed during the evaluation


F1Repeated action labels. Upkeep offers six update action ids under one label, and the row-actions line repeated "Update" six times. Labels now appear once.
F2Multi-line values broke rows. Recipe details have line breaks, which split rows across lines. Values are now joined with " / ".
F3Status dot repeated the status column. A cell's dot label is now left out when another cell of the row already says it.
F4Row panes were missing. OnTrack keeps a task's fields, relations and update timeline in the row's details drawer (pane). Reads now include it under the row.
F5Default filters reported as view state. OnTrack's Workflow filter at its default (Ongoing) was reported as something the person set. Filters at their declared default are no longer flagged.
F6Noisy search. Search matched action labels, filter options and headings. It now searches content lines only.
F7Flag labels printed as ids. A flag label such as isPersonal was printed as its id ("2"). It now shows the label's name.



Open findings


O1Reads follow the person's search and filters. Case 10: an agent sees only what the shared view shows. The note prevents wrong answers but not the gap. Remedy: parameterized reads (1c) and surface instances (1d).
O2Whole-screen reads and no diffs. One task's history (case 3) and every change notification (case 9) cost a full screen of about 8k characters. Consider a row-level read (table and row id) and change summaries in the agent view.
O3Read-only answers can only redirect. Cases 2 and 5: the agent explains where to act. Phase 1b (guarded actions with approvals) is the next step for usefulness.
O4Hidden plugins leave answers incomplete. Case 8: list_plugins leaves out plugins kept from agents, so an agent can't say whether all plugins are current. This is the intended privacy behavior. A future plugin-management phase may want to show update availability without plugin data.
O5Plain-text secrets and paths. Only fields marked sensitive or secret are masked. Plugin text (log paths, command lines) passes through as is. Processes opts out for that reason. The tree-level secret marker is planned for 1c.
O6Opening a screen has effects. Reading a screen nobody had open makes the plugin render it, and run whatever it does while open, for 60 s. That's bounded but not free, for example for plugins that poll while open.
O7Not yet tried with an LLM MCP client. Compatibility was verified with the MCP Inspector, an SDK client. Adding it to Claude Code (the command is in Settings → Agents) is the remaining check, and needs your agent configuration.



Settings → Agents





Reproduce


From the repository root: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run views, then sh plans/agent-interface-eval/tools/restart-preview.sh. Load the four archives with tools/rpc.ts 5281 development '{"operation":"load",…}', seed with tools/seed.ts, and run a case with bun plans/agent-interface-eval/tools/mcp-run.ts <case dir> <steps.json> or tools/cli-run.sh. Rebuild this page with bun plans/agent-interface-eval/tools/report.ts. Local paths in the records are replaced by placeholders such as <tmp> and <eval>.
